c74object.name: syncSuite.trajectory~
c74object.digest: Movement of one source on musical time: orbits, paths, steps on subdivisions, drift.
c74object.description: Movement of one source, designed on musical time. The input is the transport position in beats (you provide it: a signal for sample-accurate movement, or floats / position messages); every length is in beats, so shapes follow the tempo and land on the grid. The position is a pure function of the beat: nothing accumulates, so jumping, looping, scrubbing, or starting in the middle of a song always give the same position for the same beat, random shapes included (hashed from the step and the seed). Outputs: azimuth (deg, 0 = front, clockwise, -180..180), distance (0 = centre, 1 = the speaker circle) and elevation (deg) as signals, the same ranges as MultipanSync's s<n>_az / s<n>_d parameters (drive them with live.remote~: no automation is written, no undo steps); and messages: position az dist el, xyz x y z, and source n az dist with @source n, ready for syncSuite.nodes. Everything is computed in 3D (x right, y front, z up); elevation is there for 3D layouts. Display: the layout, one cycle of the movement (brighter towards its end, a tick every beat, bigger every 4) and where the source is now; path points are edited with the mouse. Cost: under 0.4% of a core per source at 48 kHz for the most complex shape (random steps), 0.05% for an orbit.

method.name: float
method.description: Outputs the messages at once (and holds the signal outputs there when no signal is connected).

attribute.name: period
attribute.description: One cycle of the shape (with loop pingpong: one way). Default 4.

attribute.name: offset
attribute.description: Where the cycle starts, e.g. 16 = the movement starts at bar 5 in 4/4. Default: 0.

attribute.name: loop
attribute.description: What happens after a cycle. once: stays at the end (and before offset, at the start). Values: 0 = loop, 1 = pingpong, 2 = once (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: quantize
attribute.description: 0 = continuous. Otherwise time moves in steps of this length (0.25 = sixteenths if beats are quarters) ...

attribute.name: glide
attribute.digest: Glide into each step (0 = jump, 1 = whole step)
attribute.description: ... and glides into each step over this share of it (0 = jump on the subdivision, 1 = the whole step, eased). Also the glide of shape steps.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Glide into each step (0 = jump, 1 = whole step)

attribute.name: shape
attribute.description: The movement. orbit: turns around the listener; pendulum: swings around azimuth; spiral: orbit while the distance (and elevation) go from start to end values; lissajous: an a:b figure; path: through the points of path, smooth (Catmull-Rom) or straight, at even times or at times; steps: hops through the path points, or the speakers when there is no path, one per step, in order forward / backward / pingpong / random (a fresh shuffle of all targets every round, never the same twice in a row), gliding over glide of each step; wander: a smooth random drift within range around azimuth / distance / elevation. Names or numbers. Values: 0 = static, 1 = orbit, 2 = pendulum, 3 = spiral, 4 = lissajous, 5 = path, 6 = steps, 7 = wander (a number or the name). Default: 1.

attribute.name: azimuth
attribute.description: Start (orbit, spiral), centre (pendulum, wander), rotation of the figure (lissajous), position (static). Default: 0.

attribute.name: distance
attribute.description: Radius; start of the spiral; centre of the wander. Default: 1.

attribute.name: elevation
attribute.description: Default: 0.

attribute.name: turns
attribute.digest: Turns per cycle (orbit, spiral; negative = counter-clockwise)
attribute.description: Orbit, spiral. Negative = counter-clockwise. Default: 1.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Turns per cycle (orbit, spiral; negative = counter-clockwise)

attribute.name: width
attribute.description: Default: 90.

attribute.name: distance_end
attribute.description: Default: 0.2.

attribute.name: elevation_end
attribute.description: Default: 0.

attribute.name: lissajous
attribute.description: Per cycle, default 1 2.

attribute.name: lissajous_phase
attribute.description: Default: 90.

attribute.name: path
attribute.digest: Path points: az dist el, az dist el, ...
attribute.description: az dist el triples (el may be left out for the last point). Edited with the mouse: click adds a point in the nearest segment, drag moves it, alt-click deletes it. path with no values clears it (steps then use the speakers).

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Path points: az dist el, az dist el, ...

attribute.name: times
attribute.digest: Path: time of each point in the cycle (0..1; empty = even)
attribute.description: One per point, 0..1 within the cycle, rising. Empty = evenly spaced. Cleared when a point is added with the mouse.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Path: time of each point in the cycle (0..1; empty = even)

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: On: Catmull-Rom (passes through every point); off: straight lines. Default: 1.

attribute.name: step
attribute.description: steps, wander. 0.25 = sixteenths if beats are quarters. Default: 0.5.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: steps. Values: 0 = forward, 1 = backward, 2 = pingpong, 3 = random (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: arc
attribute.digest: Steps: glide around the listener (else straight)
attribute.description: steps: on = the short way around (azimuth), off = straight across. Default: 1.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Steps: glide around the listener (else straight)

attribute.name: range
attribute.description: +- azimuth (deg), distance, elevation (deg). Default 90 0.3 0.

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: steps random, wander. The same seed always gives the same movement. Default: 1.

attribute.name: rotate
attribute.description: Added to the azimuth: the same movement, turned (e.g. for another source). Default: 0.

attribute.name: scale
attribute.description: Default: 1.

attribute.name: mirror
attribute.description: Default: 0.

attribute.name: speaker_coords
attribute.digest: Speaker azimuths (drawn; steps hop between them when there is no path)
attribute.description: Drawn; the targets of steps when there is no path.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Speaker azimuths (drawn; steps hop between them when there is no path)

attribute.name: speaker_elevations
attribute.description: Degrees, up, one per channel (missing = 0). All spatial computations are in 3D; the displays are top views.

attribute.name: source
attribute.digest: Source number for source <n> az dist (0 = none)
attribute.description: With n > 0 the messages include source n az dist (syncSuite.nodes / MultipanSync).

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Source number for source <n> az dist (0 = none)

attribute.name: output
attribute.digest: With a signal in: output messages at the display rate
attribute.description: At the display rate. With floats in, every float outputs. Default: 0.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: With a signal in: output messages at the display rate

attribute.name: bypass_ui
attribute.description: 1: nothing is drawn and the display timer stops; the audio and the message output are not affected (use it when the box is hidden or while performing). Default: 0.

attribute.name: no_ui
attribute.digest: No UI: a plain object box (set it when typing the object: @no_ui 1)
attribute.description: Type it with the object (mc.syncSuite.limiter~ @no_ui 1): the box looks and sizes like a standard object box, draws nothing, runs no display timer and skips the display-only metering. Max decides per class whether a box is a UI box, so the box stays resizable, but it behaves as a standard object: audio, messages and get work as usual. Default: 0.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: No UI: a plain object box (set it when typing the object: @no_ui 1)

attribute.name: interval
attribute.description: Display refresh and output rate. The processing does not depend on it. Default: 33.

attribute.name: preview
attribute.description: 0 = one cycle (8 steps for steps / wander).

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: Box background (syncSuite style: near black).

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: Labels and numbers.

attribute.name: gridcolor
attribute.description: Scales and guides.

attribute.name: color
attribute.description: Main signal colour (syncSuite hot pink).

attribute.name: speakercolor
attribute.description: Speakers.

outlet.digest: position az dist el, xyz x y z, source n az dist
